purpose: Teach: 青色/千代田/吉野/鹿島/ミシェル/帯広/朝日新聞社/小学館

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが青色のシャツを着てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was wearing a blue shirt, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Soft opening. Speaking to him the way you'd mention something small you noticed about someone he cares about. Warm, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと千代田区のお散歩したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! I went on a walk with Dad in Chiyoda.
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick delivery. Can't wait to tell her. Words tumble out a little. Small boy genuinely eager to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが吉野山の桜に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you to see the cherry blossoms at Yoshino Mountain.
lines.style: Warm, almost pleased on his behalf. Slightly lifted. Speaking as if sharing something lovely she's learned. Gentle emphasis on the future kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと鹿島サッカー観戦したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! Dad took me to watch a Kashima soccer match!
lines.style: Proud, energetic energy. He's bursting to tell her. Fast pace. The joy of having done something he wants her to know about. Genuine childlike enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがミシェルさんという哲学者のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to tell you about a philosopher named Michel.
lines.style: Calm, thoughtful. Slightly slower pace. The kind of thing shared when something interesting has been mentioned. Matter-of-fact but with genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと帯広のお菓子食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! Dad and I ate Obihiro snacks together!
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo. Simple joy. He's telling her about a small, shared moment like it matters. Childlike sincerity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが朝日新聞社の見学に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you on a tour of the Asahi Newspaper building.
lines.style: Warm observation. Slightly slower, thoughtful pace. The kind of thing shared in passing about something nice that's coming. Gentle, no fuss.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、小学館の絵本好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! I really like Shogakukan picture books!
lines.style: Happy declaration. Quick, genuine. He's sharing something he likes with someone he trusts. Not performing — just telling her. Natural, bright close.
